question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: May Day is observed internationally to honour the fight of workers for fair treatment. In 1886, many factory workers in Chicago protested for an (a) ------- workday. The protest, however, turned violent when police (b) ------- the crowd. One worker died and several others were hurt. This incident reminded everyone that workers had to (c) ------- together to claim their rights. Over time, May Day became a symbol of worker (d) ------- and sacrifice. It highlights the need for fair wages, better working hours, and a safe (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) eight-hour; (b) attacked; (c) unite; (d) struggle; (e) workplace; ● ●
